exposure: Initial maternity care facility (primary, secondary, or tertiary)
outcome: Risk of undiagnosed cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 195 women with CSP in Qingyuan, Guangdong, China, between January 2013 and December 2017
finding: Women who received initial maternity care at primary or secondary facilities had a higher risk of undiagnosed CSP, leading to more complications, longer hospital stays, and higher costs.
